title: Stage A image: NAT-087's restore-mode image with NAT-089's small root (19 Apple LaunchDaemons plists from the donor set minus wifid, backboardd and SpringBoard, plus the ps -A heartbeat) as md0; build, package, derive the session driver, tests over the payload byte for byte against NAT-087's, mutation pass, decision draft with the pre-registered A1-A8 table
acceptance: The built payload equals NAT-087's byte for byte except the command-line tag (NAT090-sa1) and the 4 MiB md0 region, which equals NAT-089's Stage A small root (sha256 recorded); the loader differs only in the words that encode the image name; the packaged RECOVERY and payload hashes are recorded.

The small root's source tree holds exactly the 19 Apple plists of NAT-089's job table plus the heartbeat, each with the recorded sha256, its label and program; the stock `Disabled` keys (syslogd true; two feature-flag conditionals) are listed and the analyser's self-starting set excludes disabled jobs.

A session driver derived from NAT-087's by counted substitutions (derive90.py --check), tests, a mutation pass over build.py and derive90.py, and a decision draft with every hash recomputed and the A1-A8 ladder fixed in advance. Nothing here measures the phone.
